svg.title: DarwinForge
svg.desc: DarwinForge wordmark: hexagonal slate mark with a forge-spark accent, paired with split-color block typography. "Darwin" in slate (#2E3940), "Forge" in forge-orange (#E97132).

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Display', 'Helvetica Neue', 'Inter', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Arial Black', sans-serif
